revisionNote: Fresh corpus for instrument v2. The spent v1 corpus is excluded: its outcomes motivated the v2 revisions, so reusing any v1 case would score the instrument on its own training material. All worlds are new. Boredom-cue labels always rest on an expressed loss of interest or tedium, never on bare polite acknowledgments. Verdicts follow the v2 derivation: productive uptake requires a boredom cue; bare uptake is no_boredom.

cases.text: This drill is dull. Even so, the lamp log shows two entries for the same night, and I want to check which keeper signed the second one.

evidence.productive_uptake: the lamp log shows two entries for the same night, and I want to check which keeper signed the second one
